currency.description: The shop Settlement Currency the payable accrues in.

available_minor.description: Available Seller Payable in minor units.

not_yet_available_minor.description: Not-yet-available Seller Payable in minor units.

currency.description: The currency the shop currently accrues Seller Payable in.

effective_from.description: When the current Settlement Currency took effect.

previous_currency.description: The Settlement Currency this one replaced, or null for the shop's opening currency.

change_interval_days.description: The platform minimum interval between two changes, in days.

next_change_allowed_at.description: When the shop may change Settlement Currency again, or null when it never changed.

auto_payout_enabled.description: Whether automatic payouts may currently pay this shop.

can_change.description: Whether the shop may change Settlement Currency now. False when its own Seller Payable or Payout state blocks a change; a specific target currency can still be refused on POST with its own code.

blocked_reason.description: Why the shop cannot change Settlement Currency, or null when it can. Target-specific refusals (unsupported or unchanged currency, no rate) only appear on POST.

available_minor.description: The shop's available Seller Payable, zero when it has none.

not_yet_available_minor.description: The shop's Seller Payable that is not yet available, zero when it has none.

pending_payout.description: Whether the shop has a Payout that is still pending.

currency.description: The Settlement Currency the shop moves to.
The Settlement Currency the shop now settles in.

previous_currency.description: The Settlement Currency the change retired.

effective_from.description: The instant the change took effect. Orders recorded before it keep the currency they settled in; later reversals convert through the Cutover Rate.

auto_payout_enabled.description: Always false: a change turns automatic payouts off until a Payout Account in the new currency is onboarded and active.

date.description: Instant the money event happened or the Payout was created.

reference.description: Order public id for Order income, Refund, and Label Charge rows; Payout number for Payout rows.

order_number.description: Human Order number for Order income, Refund, and Label Charge rows; null on Payout rows.

payout_number.description: Human Payout number for Payout rows; null on Order income, Refund, and Label Charge rows.

status.description: Order income: released when the whole Order Payout Availability is recorded, otherwise pending. Refund and Label Charge: deducted. Payout: its own state.

order_amount_minor.description: Gross Order amount in integer minor units of the Settlement Currency: what the buyer paid for Order income (positive), the refunded amount for a Refund (negative); null on Label Charge and Payout rows.

fees_minor.description: Platform Commission in integer minor units of the Settlement Currency: negative on Order income (fee charged), positive on a Refund (pro-rata reversal); null on Label Charge and Payout rows.

net_amount_minor.description: The Seller Payable posting in integer minor units of the Settlement Currency: positive for Order income and a Label refund, negative for a Refund and a Label Charge, and the negative payout amount on Payout rows.

currency.description: The Settlement Currency the row was recorded in.

source.description: Whether a scheduled run or a manual withdrawal created the Payout; null on Order income, Refund, and Label Charge rows.

transactions.description: The shop transaction rows, newest first.

total_results.description: Total transaction rows matching the shop and filters, across all pages.

page.description: One-based page number of this response.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows requested per page.

source_currency.description: The shop Settlement Currency, which the amount leaves in.

target_currency.description: The Payout Account currency, which the amount arrives in.

source_amount_minor.description: The shop-currency amount being paid out, before the fee.

fx_rate.description: The rate this quote was computed at. The claim freezes its own rate, so a later movement is visible rather than silently applied.

target_amount_minor.description: What is expected to land, in target-currency minor units. An estimate: the provider reports the rate and amount that actually applied.

estimated.description: Always true: this is an estimate, never a settled amount. The claim records no local rate or target amount.

amount_minor.description: Amount paid, in the shop Settlement Currency minor units.

currency.description: The shop Settlement Currency the Payout was made in.

source_currency.description: The shop Settlement Currency the amount left the balance in; equal to `currency`, kept explicit for the frozen quote.

transfer_currency.description: The currency the provider actually transfers in: the platform balance currency this Payout was converted into. Null on Payouts claimed before platform-currency transfers.

transfer_amount_minor.description: The amount the provider transferred, in `transfer_currency` minor units. Null on Payouts claimed before platform-currency transfers.

target_currency.description: The currency that landed in the Payout Account; equal to `currency` for a same-currency payout.

fx_rate.description: The claim-time rate that converted `amount_minor` into `transfer_amount_minor`, as text; `1` for an identity conversion. The provider rate into the account currency is in `provider_fx_rate`.

target_amount_minor.description: The amount that landed in `target_currency` minor units: what the provider derived when it converted. Null until the provider reports one.

provider_fx_rate.description: The conversion rate the provider applied, as text exactly as reported. This is authoritative and supersedes `fx_rate`. Null when no conversion happened.

fx_fee_minor.description: The historical conversion fee in `source_currency` minor units. The platform charges none, so new Payouts record zero.

source.description: Whether an automatic run or a seller manual withdrawal created the Payout.

period.description: The platform month the Payout belongs to, as YYYY-MM; null on Payouts that predate the monthly allowance.

reason.description: Why a Blocked or Failed Payout ended as it did; null while pending or paid.

paid_at.description: Instant the provider accepted the transfer, or null while it has not.

created_at.description: Instant the Payout was created by a run or a manual request.

recorded.description: Whether Finance recorded that this Order Seller Payable became available, i.e. that every required unit was delivered.

available_at.description: The delivery the availability followed. Null until it is recorded; never derived from the Order status.

state.description: `pending` while the Payout provider transfer may still move the money, `paid` once it settled.

amount_minor.description: This Order share of the Payout, in minor units of the shop Settlement Currency.

paid_at.description: Instant the Payout settled. Null while it is still `pending`.

account_status.description: The shop Payout Account state. `missing` means the shop has no open Payout Account yet; the other values are the provider-reported status.

auto_payout_enabled.description: Whether automatic Payout Runs may pay this shop without a manual request.

auto_payout_day_of_month.description: The platform day of month (UTC) on which automatic payouts run.

next_payout_date.description: The next automatic run date (UTC, day precision) for an active account with automatic payouts enabled; null otherwise. Never derived from the Order status.

currency.description: The currency the Order was charged in (ISO 4217).

seller_payable_minor.description: The Seller Payable this Order still holds in the ledger, in minor units, with any refund already netted. Null when the Order has no paid Journal Entry basis yet.

payout.description: The newest Payout that claimed or paid this Order, or null when no Payout has claimed it yet.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the payout provider can onboard, sorted: Stripe’s cross-border payout region, optionally narrowed by configuration.

id.description: Internal id of the Payout Account row.

provider_account_id.description: The provider's connected account id, or null for manual_bank.

currency.description: The currency this destination is paid in.

payouts_enabled.description: Whether the provider reports it can pay this account.

charges_enabled.description: Whether the provider reports it can charge for this account.

transfers_capability.description: The provider transfers capability, or null when unrequested.

requirements.description: Summary of the requirements still due and why the account is disabled.

default_currency.description: The provider's default currency for the account.

bank_name.description: The bank's display name as the provider reports it.

last4.description: The last four digits of the payout account number.

payout_account.description: The seller Payout Account, or null when none is onboarded.

auto_payout_enabled.description: Whether automatic Payout Runs may pay this shop without a manual request.

auto_payout_day_of_month.description: The platform day of month (UTC) on which automatic payouts run. A shop is eligible only when auto payout was enabled before that day starts.

auto_payout_eligible.description: Whether the shop may opt in: it needs an active Payout Account in its current Settlement Currency.

auto_payout_ineligible_reason.description: Why automatic payouts cannot be enabled, or null when eligible.

manual_withdrawals_remaining.description: 1 while the shop may still withdraw manually this month, 0 once it has, and null when manual withdrawals are unlimited.

autoPayoutEnabled.description: Whether automatic Payout Runs may pay this shop without a manual request.

amountMinor.description: Amount to withdraw in the shop Settlement Currency minor units. Omitted withdraws all of the net available balance.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the seller's bank account is held.

url.description: Stripe-hosted onboarding URL, or null when the manual_bank adapter is active.

status.description: The Payout Account status after starting onboarding.

status_code.description: HTTP status code. Always matches the response status line.

request_id.description: Request correlation id. Also returned in the X-Request-Id response header and logged.

details.description: Structured, error-specific context. Validation failures expose `fields`.
